cases.observed: Partition read/write plans bind validated selectors and required capabilities; missing partition_column and empty/duplicate selectors fail closed.
Reads only selected partitions within configured row/byte bounds. Replacement preserves untouched partitions and atomically replaces selected rows.
Out-of-selector rows are rejected and the target transaction rolls back.

A managed HTTP repair and headless backfill execute against live PostgreSQL; duplicate backfill idempotency returns the same child; only selected partitions change; report/status and parent, submission, attempt and lineage identities are persisted.
Existing managed rerun/replay lifecycle remains green alongside repair/backfill.

safety_boundaries: Selectors are bounded and validated before admission/execution.
Required provider capabilities are explicit; unsupported bindings fail closed.
Replacement and effect receipt share the target transaction.
No secret values or source rows are recorded in this evidence.
